# Nara Charm

> Nara Charm is a heritage-inspired jewelry studio with bracelets, necklaces, earrings and phone charms. The studio section presents new design previews and their visual references.

## Shop and design

- [Shop jewelry](https://naracharm.com/shop): The catalog with category, collection and availability filters.
- [Collections](https://naracharm.com/collections): Shop collections, product categories and studio collections.
- [Inside the studio](https://naracharm.com/studio): Design previews and collection notes.
- [Our craft](https://naracharm.com/our-craft): The design details behind wirework, braided cords and layered shapes.

## Guides and service

- [The Nara Journal](https://naracharm.com/blog): Guides to materials, fit, care, styling, gifts, motifs and stone colors.
- [Jewelry size guide](https://naracharm.com/size-guide): How to measure for a bracelet or necklace.
- [Shipping](https://naracharm.com/shipping): Current rates, delivery estimates and destination information.
- [Returns](https://naracharm.com/returns): Return conditions and instructions.
- [Contact](https://naracharm.com/contact): Ask about a specific product, design or order.
- [Sitemap](https://naracharm.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages.
